chunks: Abu Jaʿfar عليه السلام made a bequest of eight hundred dirhams for his mourning gathering, and he regarded that as being from the sunnah (prophetic tradition).
Because the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم said: “Prepare food for the family of Jaʿfar ibn Abī Ṭālib, for they have been preoccupied.”

key_terms.أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ: Abu Jaʿfar, Imam al-Baqir عليه السلام
key_terms.بِثَمَانِمِائَةِ دِرْهَمٍ: with eight hundred dirhams as a specified sum of money
key_terms.لِآلِ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ: for the family of Jaʿfar ibn Abī Ṭālib
key_terms.لِلسُّنَّةِ: as part of the sunnah (prophetic tradition)

ai.seo_question: What hadith supports preparing food for the bereaved family during mourning?
ai.summary: This report states that Abu Jaʿfar عليه السلام designated funds for his mourning gathering and viewed this practice as rooted in the sunnah (prophetic tradition). It supports the practice of serving the bereaved family, based on the statement of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم concerning the family of Jaʿfar ibn Abī Ṭālib.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.546 - Imam al-Baqir (as) made a will specifying 800 dirhams to be used for his mourning gathering (ma'tam), as he saw this as part of the tradition (sunnah).
This was because the Messenger of Allah (sw) said: "Prepare food for the family of Ja'far ibn Abi Talib, for they are preoccupied [by their loss]."
